programs.summary: Argentina prepaid Visa crypto card integrated with Ripio Wallet. Current Ripio terms identify Digipayments S.A.U. and Pomelo Fintech Services S.A.S. as co-issuers; card purchases can be funded by pesos or by selling the selected digital asset into available fiat balance.

Argentina prepaid Mastercard integrated with Buenbit, supporting payment from fiat or crypto balances through conversion to pesos. Current terms identify BKR ARGENTINA S.A. as issuer; the 2022 relaunch generation also used Pomelo infrastructure.

Argentina prepaid Mastercard integrated with belo for spending pesos and supported digital currencies. The merchant receives local fiat after the card-payment conversion flow; the precise regulated issuer is not inferred from the first-party material reviewed in this batch.

providers.summary: Argentina payment-services company identified in current Ripio Card terms as a co-issuer of the prepaid card.

Latin American card-infrastructure provider identified in current Ripio terms as a co-issuer and by Pomelo as providing issuing and payment-processing infrastructure for Ripio Card; also an evidenced infrastructure partner for Buenbit's 2022 Mastercard generation.
Argentina prepaid-card issuer explicitly identified in current Buenbit Mastercard terms as issuer and card-service provider.

relations.scope_note: Current Ripio Card terms identify Digipayments S.A.U. as one of two co-issuers. No earlier start date is inferred from the current agreement.
Current Ripio Card terms identify Pomelo Fintech Services S.A.S. as one of two co-issuers.
Pomelo describes its payment-processing infrastructure as powering the Argentina Ripio Card launch; the current Ripio terms also retain Pomelo in the card stack.
Current Ripio terms identify Visa acceptance in Argentina; the 2023 Argentina launch generation is also documented as Visa.
Current Buenbit terms explicitly identify BKR ARGENTINA S.A. as the issuer of the prepaid Mastercard.
Mastercard's Buenbit relaunch statement identifies Pomelo as the strategic infrastructure partner for the 2022 generation. No current issuer role is assigned to Pomelo for Buenbit.
Current Buenbit terms and the 2022 relaunch statement identify Mastercard as the network.
belo and Mastercard identify the Argentina prepaid card as Mastercard. No issuer relation is inferred from weaker third-party material.

events.title: Ripio Card launches in Argentina with Pomelo infrastructure
events.description: Pomelo announced the Argentina market launch of Ripio virtual crypto cards on February 8, 2023 and described its issuing and payment-processing infrastructure behind the product. Current Ripio terms identify the card as Visa and co-issued by Digipayments and Pomelo.

events.title: Buenbit relaunches its Mastercard generation
events.description: Mastercard announced Buenbit's relaunch of its crypto Mastercard in Argentina on October 6, 2022, with instant crypto-to-peso conversion and Pomelo as infrastructure partner. This is recorded as a relaunch rather than the original product launch.

events.title: belo launches prepaid Mastercard in Argentina
events.description: Mastercard announced the first 1,000 belo prepaid Mastercard cards in Argentina on February 21, 2022, enabling users to spend crypto balances through automatic conversion to fiat at purchase time.
